name: Tata Elxsi Limited
summary: Tata Elxsi Limited provides product design and engineering, systems integration, and support services in India, the United States, Europe, and Internationally. The company operates through two segments, Systems Integration and Support, and Software Development and Services. It offers iCX, a SaaS-based solution for automating, monitoring, and managing CPEs; and AIVA, an AI-based video analytics platform that automates video tagging, object detection, content indexing, and metadata generation.
